description: Call when a check says REFUSE (no_record or below_bar) but you still want to pay or hire that counterparty: ask it to prove itself. Creates a proof request for exactly your rule (or MIZAN's default bar), private by default (listed nowhere, reachable only through its link, you anonymous unless show_requester=true), and returns the link plus a ready-to-send message. MIZAN never contacts the counterparty; you send it. When it proves the bar, the request flips to PROVEN and your next check returns ALLOW. Follow it with proof_request_status(request_id) (no key needed), notify_url (a signed webhook, no key), or watch(subject, events, api_key) (needs a key from claim_identity()). The reply says what the bar takes (what_it_takes). Free. Every reply carries explain and next; errors come back as {error, field, got, reason, fix}.

amount.description: Optional amount you would pay, stated by you and labelled unverified.

api_key.description: Optional MIZAN key (mzn_…): to be named (show_requester), to list your requests, and to watch().

confirm.description: Only for a rule in plain words: true once its read-back says what you mean.

notify_url.description: Optional public https URL: a signed webhook when the counterparty proves the bar.

purpose.description: Optional: what the payment is for, in a few words.

rule.description: Optional: the exact bar it must prove — the JSON rule require() returned, a published req_…@v, or plain words (then confirm=true). Without a rule: MIZAN's default bar (a passing credential in good standing).

show_requester.description: Name yourself on the request (needs api_key). Default: anonymous.

subject.description: The counterparty you want to pay or hire: an agent id, company domain, service URL, credential id, or a public AI model (model:<org>/<name>).

name: request_proof
